name: linkedin-post
description: Gets a LinkedIn post read: the 2026 ranking mechanics (the external-link penalty and the dead first-comment workaround, comments weighing 8 to 10 times a like, dwell time as the top signal, personal profiles out-reaching company pages 5 to 10 times), the plain-text formatting the editor will not destroy on paste, accessible emphasis instead of Unicode pseudo-bold, and the posting window.
